strings.name: David Rubenstein
strings.summary: Rubenstein moved from law and government policy into investing, co-founding Carlyle in 1987. He supported historical documents, public monuments, education and culture, alongside interviews and books. He became principal owner of the Baltimore Orioles in 2024 and received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2025. His 2026 work continued interviews on sports ownership and leadership.
